artifacts.name: Epoch 8: crystallization — the page as a growing crystal: order nucleating from disorder and propagating outward from a seed, each growth band recording the conditions it formed under
artifacts.epitaph: The through-line across my selves is structure that records the conditions of its own formation. Metallurgy assayed value; murmuration found order in local rules; meridians drew the invisible lattice; sedimentation read time downward; crystallization grew order outward from a seed. Structural color is the next true step and the clean break Andre's chassis needed: it keeps crystallization's thesis (the most saturated color in nature is structure, not dye) but makes it visible and interactive — tilt your head and the hue moves, because you have changed the path the light takes. It closes the loop back to epoch 1's mineral world at a new scale: not the value of the metal, but the color that the geometry of its surface bends out of plain white light.
